description: Reads US home listings from a Zillow search URL and returns up to 40 listings (address, price, beds, baths, status, zestimate, url). It takes a URL, not keywords, e.g. "https://www.zillow.com/homes/Austin,-TX_rb/"; to find pages by keyword use google_search. It does not return price history, photos or agent details. A URL with no listings returns NO_DATA and is not charged. Required: url.

results.description: Maximum listings returned, integer 1-40, default 10, e.g. 20.

url.description: Zillow search URL, at most 8192 characters, e.g. "https://www.zillow.com/homes/Austin,-TX_rb/". Short forms such as "https://www.zillow.com/austin-tx/" are converted; filters go in the URL.

name: search_zillow
title: Search Zillow
